title: A Ember for the Garden
author: Ivo Hartwell
blurb: Tamsin Joubert, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
